name: 99603 · Homer, AK
findings: ZIP 99603 (Homer) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (63%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99603 (Homer) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 99603 (Homer) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
